meta.name: pol-probe-advisor
meta.description: Select the right Proof of Life (PoL) probe based on hypothesis, risk, and resources. Use this to match the validation method to the real learning goal, not tooling comfort.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据假设、风险和资源选择验证方法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在验证产品假设，需要匹配最适合的验证方法。
copy.tagline_en: Match validation methods to hypothesis, risk, and resources
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to choose the right proof-of-life probe for your product hypothesis.

howto.what: Claude会通过一系列问题引导你明确待验证的假设、具体风险、时间线和可用资源，然后从五种验证探针中推荐最匹配的类型，并可选择生成对应的文档。
howto.when: 当你有一个明确但不确定选用哪种验证方法的假设或风险时触发。例如，你说出“哪个PoL探针适合测试这个想法”等请求时。

say.text: 我想测试这个新功能的技术可行性，该用哪种验证方法？
我的假设是“如果简化注册步骤，用户完成率会提升”，帮我选个验证探针。

howto.what_en: Claude asks questions to clarify your hypothesis, risk, timeline, and resources, then recommends one of five PoL probe types and offers to generate documentation.
howto.when_en: When you have a specific hypothesis or risk but are unsure which validation method to use; triggered by requests like "Which PoL probe should I use?"

say_en.text: I want to test the technical feasibility of this new feature, which method should I use?
say_en.note: Claude will guide to Feasibility Check.

say_en.text: My hypothesis is 'if we simplify signup, completion rate increases'. Help me pick a probe.
